description: Check how a place name resolves before you put it in a request. Returns the places whose name starts with `q` (2+ characters), with city, region and country exactly as the job index stores them, the string the search `location` filter takes for each, and the `{ country, region, city }` object the feed (`POST /api/jobs/feed`) takes in `locations`. This is the free place lookup, not the billed geocoder (`GET /api/locations/geocode`), which this server never calls. Needs the Jobo API key in this server's `Authorization: Bearer` header; a sandbox key (jbe_test_…) cannot use it. Free: rate limited, never billed.

q.description: Start of a place name, e.g. 'berlin', 'san fran', 'texas'.

name: find_locations
title: Check a place name
